candidates.name: V10a_final_h45
candidates.role: final design: V8 deep-transport architecture with cooling h=40->45 W/m2K — adopted after OKane2022 robustness showed T_max 333.315 K at h=40 (0.165 K over the 333.15 line); h=45 passes both bases (OKane2022 SPMe: T_max 331.883 K, anode +17.3 mV)

llm_reason: R5 established V8 (h=40) passes all criteria on Chen2020 DFN (ret 0.9945, ED 564.88 Wh/kg, ED_vol 969.56 Wh/L, T_max 330.47 K, anode +30.1 mV) and passed the cold-start honesty check (ret 0.9945 from genuine 253.15 K start, T_max 257.5 K confirms cold). OKane2022 re-validation at h=40: retention 0.9793 passes, anode +17.5 mV passes, but T_max 333.315 K fails by 0.165 K -> one notch stronger cooling. h=45 passes OKane2022 SPMe (T_max 331.883, anode +17.3 mV); h=50 erodes the anode margin further (+15.1 mV). Adopt h=45; verify the full DFN set on Chen2020 (judged) and DFN safety+retention on OKane2022 (robustness).
